issues.detail: The Greek 'προφητων' (prophets) refers to the books of the Prophets. The Vietnamese translation 'các nhà tiên tri' refers to the people (the prophets themselves). This changes the meaning from a reading of scripture to a reading of people.

The Greek 'απεστειλαν οι αρχισυναγωγοι' specifies that it was the 'rulers/leaders of the synagogue' who sent the men. The Vietnamese 'các quản lý nhà hội' is a functional translation, but the Greek emphasizes the authority of the leaders sending the messengers.
